plugins.name: dart-lsp
plugins.description: Dart/Flutter language server (Dart Analysis Server in LSP mode) for code intelligence

plugins.name: flutter-toolkit
plugins.description: Flutter test gates for a shared machine — plan-test slot budget, per-line coverage and mutation score over the diff (Dart and JS/TS)

plugins.name: session-journal
plugins.description: Cross-session task-state journal — which threads are in flight and where each one lives, surviving context compaction, /clear, and resume

plugins.name: google-reporting
plugins.description: Google Analytics 4 and Search Console readers — usage, indexing status, search performance, and sitemap health, via keyless service-account impersonation

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Rules that fire on their own: hooks that warn about or block known mistakes as a command runs, and a short discipline loaded at session start

plugins.name: reclaim-space
plugins.description: Developer-disk reclamation on macOS — regenerable build output and toolchain caches, measured by the real free-space delta, plus a free-space floor on new git worktrees

plugins.name: assistant
plugins.description: The founder's assistant — request → decision brief → screens → PR, across projects, with the style-pack and ui-text-pack rulebooks its reviewers grade against.

plugins.name: mother-tongue
plugins.description: Per-locale writing rules for the agent's own prose — detects the conversation's language each turn, attaches that locale's rules and the English ones for code and commits to the prompt, and blocks replies and commit messages that use its banned terms
